name: DiversiFi Guardian
tagline: You set the rules, the Guardian operates within them, and every decision is explainable and verifiable.
description: DiversiFi is an FX-risk intelligence layer with a constrained agent. The Guardian detects a visitor's country/currency, quantifies their real FX risk against dollars, euros or gold, lets them choose a values-aligned protection plan, and then watches that plan. By default the Guardian only PROPOSES moves — the user signs each one in their own wallet. Autonomous execution exists only where the user has granted an ERC-7715 permission that their own smart account enforces on-chain (Celo, Celo Sepolia, Arbitrum); unconfigured or ineligible chains fail closed to one-tap proposals. There is no custody: savings stay in the user's wallet. Every decision is recorded on the chain-aware RecommendationLedger and anchored to 0G Storage, with a readable reasoning echo whose hash matches the on-chain commitment. Businesses that earn in one currency and buy in another get per-payment-cycle FX drag quantification. The values system (Africapitalism, Buen Vivir, Confucian, Gotong Royong, Islamic Finance, Pan-Caribbean, Global Diversification, Custom) shapes the plan, never the authority: data → deterministic risk calculation → constrained strategy → AI explanation → user approval → on-chain execution.
author: thisyearnofear

capabilities.name: FX-Risk Intelligence
capabilities.description: Country-specific currency risk against dollars, euros and gold over 1/3/5-year horizons, with dated, cited corridor signals (≤14 days fresh) and curated token provenance.

capabilities.name: Constrained Protection
capabilities.description: The Guardian loop monitors macro/FX/inflation signals and proposes plan-aligned moves within a user-set daily limit. Proposal-only by default; autonomous only under a user-signed, wallet-enforced ERC-7715 permission.

capabilities.name: Verifiable AI
capabilities.description: Every recommendation is recorded on the chain-aware RecommendationLedger (0x3BCf…369C on Celo, Arbitrum and 0G) and anchored to 0G Storage. Any tx hash can be verified via GET /api/agent/zero-g-ledger?verify=<txHash>.

capabilities.name: Philosophy / Values System
capabilities.description: Values-aligned protection plans — Africapitalism, Buen Vivir, Islamic Finance, Confucian, Gotong Royong, Pan-Caribbean, Global Diversification, Custom — that shape the plan's legs and the explanation, never the deterministic risk calculation.

capabilities.name: Per-Cycle FX Drag
capabilities.description: For businesses earning in one currency and paying suppliers in USD: what FX timing costs this payment cycle, as a dated scenario, never a forecast.

capabilities.name: Chain-Aware Routing
capabilities.description: Routes local-stablecoin savings on Celo/Mento and deep-liquidity/RWA yield on Arbitrum; Arc and HashKey ledgers remain live for evidence.

capabilities.name: MCP Tool Server
capabilities.description: Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP) exposing the same read-only intelligence to third-party agents, plus a single write tool that files a PROPOSAL into the owner's Guardian queue — subject to the same wallet-signature approval as every other move.

networks.name: Celo Mainnet
networks.role: savings-and-local-stables; proposals and ERC-7715 execution; RecommendationLedger

networks.name: Arbitrum One
networks.role: deep-liquidity and RWA yield; ERC-7715 execution; RecommendationLedger

networks.name: HashKey Chain
networks.role: ledger only (APAC rail machinery retained, not on the plan)
